descripcion_html:
Somos el mayor proveedor de fibra óptica del mundo. Ofrecemos soluciones integrales y con una cartera de productos diversa y flexible, con especial presencia en las industrias de las telecomunicaciones, servicios públicos, transporte, petroquímica y médica. En el Perú estamos a cargo del Proyecto Regional para implementar fibra óptica en 4 regiones del País (Arequipa, Ancash, San Martín y La Libertad) y requerimos profesionales con experiencia para nuestro staff

Integrate, commission, and provide technical support for Nokia and Fortinet network equipment and CPEs, performing end-to-end connectivity validation and troubleshooting to ensure the proper functioning of last-mile connectivity solutions.

Additionally, you will have the opportunity to coordinate with field and support teams, analyze technical incidents, and contribute to the implementation and continuity of connectivity solutions.

What Will Your Responsibilities Be?

  • Integrate and commission Nokia / Fortinet last-mile equipment (CPEs).

  • Troubleshoot Nokia/Nuage NSG and Fortinet CPEs, identifying end-to-end connectivity issues.

  • Validate interfaces, VLANs, IP addressing, MAC tables, ARP, and basic service connectivity on Nokia network equipment.

  • Troubleshoot Access Points (APs) and their connectivity within last-mile solutions.

  • Perform basic network equipment checks when required during troubleshooting.

  • Provide technical follow-up on integrations and coordinate with field personnel and support teams.

  • Document tests, incidents, and integration progress.


Requisitos:
What Are We Looking For?

  • Experience in Nokia / Fortinet CPE integration and troubleshooting.

  • Knowledge of Nokia/Nuage NSG solutions is highly desirable.

  • Understanding of end-to-end (E2E) last-mile connectivity and the ability to identify points of failure.

  • Strong theoretical knowledge of SD-WAN solutions.

  • Working knowledge of VLANs, IP, DHCP, ARP, MAC tables, and basic routing.

  • Experience with or knowledge of Access Points (APs).

  • Familiarity with Nokia SR OS / CLI and basic troubleshooting commands is desirable.

  • Ability to identify the point of failure before escalating an issue.

  • Intermediate to advanced English proficiency (Indispensable).


Beneficios What We Offer

  • Employment on the payroll with all legally mandated benefits.

  • Career growth opportunities.

  • A positive work environment.
